items.caption:
6.9% of people have sleepwalked.
A review of 51 studies estimated 6.9% at least once in life, and in the past year about 5% of children and 1.5% of adults (the authors flag a high risk of bias, so read these as rough estimates); it usually starts in deep non-REM sleep, not in REM. If it keeps costing you sleep, talk to a doctor.
